description: Download a blueprint as an Agent Skills directory. Returns a JSON manifest with all files (SKILL.md, reference docs, scripts) that can be written to disk for any coding agent to consume. Use this instead of reading full blueprint/business-case/plan data via individual tools.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

platform.description: Target deployment platform (e.g., 'servicenow', 'openclaw'). Includes a platform-specific deployment guide.

name: download_blueprint
